snippet.title: Narnok - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Narnok, an auto battler card-based strategy game developed by Mastrowcorp. Players will make alien lineups to build synergies, gather resources, and engage in asynchronous battles across collapsing universes. Narnok is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
